arguments.summary: A Golden Ticket attack was executed after an initial phishing compromise on user CORP\jsmith's workstation (WS-FIN-042). The attacker used a malicious email attachment to execute an encoded PowerShell command, which downloaded and launched a Cobalt Strike beacon. This foothold was used to perform DCSync attacks against the domain controller (10.0.1.10), extracting the krbtgt hash. This allowed the creation of forged Kerberos tickets, leading to a full domain credential compromise. Immediate domain-wide credential revocation was executed to contain the breach.

Outlook spawned an encoded PowerShell process to download a remote payload.
PowerShell executed rundll32.exe to load the downloaded beacon.dll from the user's Temp directory.
Cobalt Strike beacon established C2 communication with external IP 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS.
Attacker performed lateral movement via SMB to file server 10.0.5.50.
DCSync attack detected on domain controller 10.0.1.10. Golden Ticket attack confirmed. Incident declared.
Containment: All domain credentials revoked via IAM/PAM system to invalidate all Kerberos tickets.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs via entropy and strings"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC-by-sa 4.0"
    strings:
        $a = "beacon.dll" fullword ascii
        $b = { 6A 40 68 [2-4] 01 00 00 6A 00 6A 00 68 [4] 68 [4] FF 15 [4] 8B C8 } // VirtualAlloc call pattern
        $c = "HttpSendRequest" fullword ascii
    condition:
        uint32(0) == 0x5A4D and $a and $b and $c
}
